status: memory parity disproven at measured100000-session contract
scope: Same frozen server executable selects native WebSocket or WebTransport; same frozen capacity client.100000 sessions,6250 rooms,1KiB bodies,4s at1message/user/second, all400000 measured deliveries verified. Normal allocator RSS/timing and replacement-allocator requested bytes are separate runs. Kernel costs are separate, incomplete accounting; never add buffer limits to allocations or add requested bytes to RSS.

heap_diagnostic.scope: Replacement allocator; client waits at every captured gate. Exclude CPU, latency and RSS from ordinary comparisons. Logical cleanup can precede deferred QUIC memory release. Kernel counters and socket object estimates are separate, incomplete kernel accounting.

server.scope: Process-owned connected TCP sockets or bound UDP sockets, filtered by the requested ports. skmem fields are separate counters, not an additive total. Buffer limits are not allocations. Slab object estimate excludes slab overhead, protocol buffers, route/conntrack state and other kernel resources. TIME_WAIT port matches have no live fd and are reported separately. This is not complete kernel memory accounting.

initial_capture_failure.scope: Connected/ready/measured dumps valid; later collector5s timeout caused controller failure and teardown. Not a successful retirement verification. New capture waits for SIGUSR2 handler unblock and stable complete file with30s diagnostic watchdog. Original failure preserved; maintained tool completes all gates for both transports.

reproduction.note: Repeat an ordinary capacity receipt with --receipt, --prefix, --output and optionally --slab-sizes. Every profile gate pauses the client. Allocation-profiler CPU/latency/RSS are not ordinary performance.

limitations: Ordinary runs and heap diagnostics are individual scale confirmations, not statistical confidence intervals.
Done logical resource gauges can reach zero before deferred QUIC retirement and endpoint tables release storage. Exit profile is separate; no retained-RSS leak inference.
Socket object estimates exclude slab overhead, socket/file/inode metadata, protocol buffers, route/conntrack state and other kernel costs. SKMEM counters are not an additive total.

Capacity contract explicitly uses64KiB max messages and256KiB session queue bytes; exact server command retained by source receipts. This does not change the product default or replace large-message verification.
